verdict.rationale: Orama documents an `insertMultiple` function recommended for large record sets because it avoids blocking the event loop. Orama Cloud data sources can be updated independently. Nothing shows async indexing task tracking or throughput at millions-of-documents scale. Missing for 10: async task/job status tracking for indexing completion, evidence of bulk import performance at millions-of-documents scale, a Cloud bulk-ingest API, independent corroboration.
